title: A Asset for the Protocol Revisited
premise: Ansel Ashgrove, a fixer for the Protocol—an embassy that exists on no map—receives a meeting invitation from a handler who died three weeks ago. The invitation pulls her into a live operation: a staged 'accident' targeting the Protocol's own founding families, orchestrated by the dead handler's ghost network and a mole inside the Protocol's inheritance committee. As Ansel unravels the plot, she discovers the attack is a test of loyalty designed by the man who trained her, and that her own name sits on the inheritance list. In the end she must choose between protecting the institution that gave her belonging and exposing the truth that would dissolve it—she burns the Protocol's charter to save its people, and finally sleeps through the night.
about_author: Ansel Lockridge is the pen name of a former diplomatic security consultant who spent eleven years in posts he still cannot name. He writes thrillers from a farmhouse in Wales, where he keeps his old passports in a locked biscuit tin.

chapters.title: The Invitation from the Dead
chapters.summary: Ansel Ashgrove, sleepless since the incident in Vilnius, receives a calendar invite from handler Marcus Vane—dead three weeks. POV: Ansel. The beat is dread sharpening into compulsion: she opens the attachment despite every instinct, finding a time, a place, and her own codename.

chapters.title: Embassy of No Address
chapters.summary: Ansel walks the Protocol's unmarked corridors, testing who else got the invite. POV: Ansel. She learns three senior officers received it too—and one has already gone missing. Emotional beat: the chill of realizing the institution she serves is frightened of its own mail.

chapters.title: Tea with a Ghost
chapters.summary: At the meeting, a voice-altered stranger delivers Vane's posthumous briefing: an attack disguised as an industrial accident, timed to the Protocol's centenary gala. POV: Ansel. Beat: grief curdling into suspicion—was Vane murdered, or did he stage his own death?

chapters.title: The Inheritance List
chapters.summary: Ansel decodes Vane's cipher: the target list is the Protocol's founding families' descendants, and her own name is on it. POV: Ansel. Beat: belonging inverted into vulnerability—the family that never adopted her wants her dead.

chapters.title: Deputy Director's Smile
chapters.summary: Deputy Director Corliss Hale assigns Ansel to 'monitor' the threat, but her questions feel like traps. POV: Ansel, with a brief Hale interlude. Beat: the first clear note that the mole may sit very high.

chapters.title: Vilnius, Again
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: the incident that broke Ansel's sleep, told in fragments—a burned safehouse, an order she obeyed, a civilian casualty. POV: Ansel. Beat: guilt established as the lever her enemy will pull.

chapters.title: The Widow's Ledger
chapters.summary: Ansel visits Vane's widow, who hands over his hidden ledger of off-book payments routed through the inheritance committee. POV: Ansel. Beat: loyalty to the dead tested against loyalty to the living institution.

chapters.title: Tail on the Embankment
chapters.summary: Someone follows Ansel; a brutal foot chase ends with her attacker dead by a method only Protocol cleaners use. POV: Ansel. Beat: paranoia—the institution is erasing threads, and she is holding one.

chapters.title: Committee of Quiet Men
chapters.summary: Ansel infiltrates the inheritance committee's records vault and finds her codename added to the list two days before Vane died. POV: Ansel. Beat: cold fury hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Man Who Taught Her
chapters.summary: Ansel confronts her old trainer, Aldous Reeve, retired and dying; he admits Vane contacted him before the death. POV: Reeve, then Ansel. Beat: the mentor she trusts most may be the architect—or her only ally.

chapters.title: Signal in the Static
chapters.summary: Ansel intercepts the attack's trigger signal test: a gas main breach timed to the gala's toast. POV: Ansel. Beat: the clock starts—nine days to the centenary.

chapters.title: Hale's Confession, Almost
chapters.summary: Hale corners Ansel, offers protection, and lets slip knowledge of the Vilnius order she never reported. POV: Ansel. Beat: betrayal—the deputy director knew about the incident all along.

chapters.title: The Missing Officer Found
chapters.summary: Ansel locates the vanished officer, drugged and hidden in a Protocol safehouse; his testimony names a courier inside the committee. POV: the officer, then Ansel. Beat: hope with a hairline crack—his memory is chemically unreliable.

chapters.title: Ghost Network Assembled
chapters.summary: Ansel builds an off-book team of Vane's old contacts, operating outside the Protocol that trained them all. POV: Ansel. Beat: belonging redefined—family chosen, not assigned.

chapters.title: The Courier's Price
chapters.summary: Ansel flips the courier, who reveals the attack is funded from the founding families' own trust. POV: the courier, then Ansel. Beat: inheritance as weapon—the legacy devouring its heirs.

chapters.title: Reeve's Deathbed Chess
chapters.summary: Reeve, dying, gives Ansel the final cipher key and confesses he built the ghost network as a failsafe against the committee. POV: Reeve. Beat: the mentor's loyalty was real, but his plan required Ansel to be bait.

chapters.title: Bait in the Gala Light
chapters.summary: Ansel lets herself be listed as attending the centenary gala, wearing a wire the mole will recognize. POV: Ansel. Beat: terror worn as armor—she is the accident's intended face.

chapters.title: The Mole Unmasked
chapters.summary: At the gala, the trap springs: the mole is Protocol Director Ilsa Brandt, Vane's superior, executing the founders' purge to seize the trust. POV: Ansel. Beat: the institution's father-figure exposed as its executioner.

chapters.title: Nine Minutes to the Toast
chapters.summary: Brandt triggers the gas breach early; Ansel races the building's systems with the ghost network, evacuating guests while Hale blocks the exits. POV: Ansel, intercut. Beat: climax begins—every loyalty cashed in at once.

chapters.title: What Ansel Chose
chapters.summary: Ansel confronts Brandt in the archive; offered reinstatement and erasure of Vilnius, she refuses, broadcasting the committee's files instead. POV: Ansel. Beat: truth over belonging—she burns the charter to save the people.

chapters.title: Aftermath of a Name
chapters.summary: The Protocol dissolves quietly; officers scatter to new lives, Hale arrested, Ansel's name cleared of Vilnius but her career dead. POV: Ansel. Beat: grief for the family that was never real, gratitude for the one she built.

chapters.title: Sleeping Through the Night
chapters.summary: Months later, Ansel tends Reeve's grave, receives a plain thank-you note from the surviving heirs, and goes home to an unalarmed door. POV: Ansel. Beat: resolution—she sleeps through the night, and wakes unafraid.
